messages:
Alex M: Quick check — I’m seeing a small spike in 502/504s from ingress-west around 21:08–21:12 UTC. Gateway_service 5xx rate jumped to ~0.7% for 10m. Can someone point me to the best dashboard + a quick path to sample traces/logs?

Kim R: Which service exactly? gateway or public-api?

Alex M: gateway (prod). The route is /v1/generate. Not sure if this is overload or upstream timeouts.

Jon P: Use the ingress-ops Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.team/d/ingress-ops — top-left panel is '5xx by route'. Click the spike to open the trace links.

Alex M: thanks — that helps. I don’t see request ids on the panel though, just a heatmap. Any quick Loki/Jaeger queries I can run if I have a sample time window?

Kim R: Loki quick query for the time window:
```
{job="gateway"} |= "request_id" |~ "5.." | json
```
Then filter `request_id="<id>"`. Jaeger/Traces: search by service=gateway and time, then look for spans with http.status_code 502/504.

Jon P: Also the Observability UI supports request lookup: /observability/requests?start=...&end=... and you can paste request_id there. If you have a request header `x-request-id: abc123`, try: `/observability/requests?q=abc123`.

Alex M: Found a couple of request ids: abc123, def456. Logs show backend returned 504 for the same timestamps. Looks like upstream timeout.

Kim R: If upstream is timing out, check backend pod CPU/latency and any recent deploys. Any deploys in the 21:00 window?

observability-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy to prod finished by @ci-user at 2026-03-16T20:58:12Z — version v1.14.3.

Jon P: Yep that deploy is in the window. Suggest: 1) confirm backend latency with `histogram_latency_ms{service="backend",handler="/generate"}` 2) collect a few traces for 21:00-21:15 and attach one sample to the incident.

Alex M: I grabbed one trace link and a log snippet. Looks like backend was busy, requests queued at nginx for ~2.4s then backend timed out at 5s.

Kim R: For alerts — current prod gateway 5xx alert fires at >=0.5% for 5m. That’s pretty sensitive. If this is deploy-caused transient flakiness we can either tweak the alert to 0.8% for 10m or add a 3m debounce. Thoughts?

Jon P: My preference is debounce. Increasing thresholds hides regressions. Proposal: add a 3m rolling suppression for deploys (if a deploy tag present) and bump to 0.75% for 10m as a guardrail.

Alex M: Sounds good. For short-term triage I muted the alert for the gateway-prod channel for 15m.

Kim R: Created a quick ticket: ENG-6543 to track tuning and deploy rollback investigation. 

Alex M: Thanks all — attaching the trace + log links in the ticket. If anything else pops up I’ll re-open the alert. :thumbsup:

Jon P: If it recurs after rollback we should scale backend and check connection pool settings.

Kim R: FYI, saved useful dashboard bookmarks: ▸ Ingress Ops -> 5xx by route ▸ Gateway -> per-instance latency ▸ Backend -> request queue length. Share if useful.

Alex M: Super helpful. Closing this thread for now.
